description: Compute the full sequence of delays an exponential-backoff retry policy would actually produce, given a base delay, multiplier, and max retry count, optionally capped at a max delay and with full/equal jitter ranges, plus the total best-case and worst-case wait across all retries. Distinct from build_retry_after_header, which builds a single HTTP Retry-After response header.

baseDelayMs.description: Delay before the first retry, in milliseconds

jitter.description: "full" randomizes uniformly between 0 and the nominal delay; "equal" randomizes between half the nominal delay and the full value

maxDelayMs.description: Optional cap applied to every computed delay

maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts to compute (1-50)

multiplier.description: Factor the delay is multiplied by after each attempt

name: calculate_retry_backoff_schedule
